input.text: Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 applies. That Directive also applies to the same conduct.

_note: The BARE standalone anaphora path ('That Directive', with no pinpoint chain attached at all -- handled entirely separately from the chain+anaphora path) must ALSO be typed. _nearest_designation() now takes the anaphora's own type word and filters EXTERNAL candidates by KIND; with no Directive ever named, 'unnamed (see note)' is used, never the nearer Regulation.
